remarks: Tucked away at the end of a quiet dead-end road, this beautiful country retreat offers exceptional privacy and a peaceful escape from the noise and bustle of everyday life. Nestled within a picturesque valley of rolling wooded terrain, the property is an inviting setting for a weekend getaway, hunting camp, or year-round country residence. A private entrance leads to a distinctive 1,155 sq. ft. custom log cabin, built in 1981 and rich with the rustic charm of an old-fashioned trapper's retreat. Traditional log construction, warm wood finishes, and an impressive stone fireplace create an authentic cabin atmosphere, complemented by modern improvements for comfortable living. The open-concept interior features two bedrooms, a spacious loft with room for two additional beds, and a newly remodeled full bathroom. A covered front porch provides a relaxing place to enjoy morning coffee, peaceful surroundings, and the sights and sounds of nature. Additional features include a durable metal roof, well, septic, electric service, and a potential secondary oil heat source. The surrounding landscape features rolling topography, mature trees, and wooded hillsides, creating an appealing setting for outdoor recreation. An established trail network provides access through portions of the property for ATV riding, exploring, and pursuing whitetail deer and wild turkey. A detached garage and separate workshop, both equipped with electric service, offer practical storage for ATVs, tools, firewood, and recreational equipment. Despite its secluded location, the property offers the potential for comfortable year-round living, with snow removal service available at the road turnaround. Gas, mineral, timber, and oil rights convey with the sale, and there is no gas well located on the property. Whether you envision a private hunting retreat, family gathering place, or peaceful country home, this unique property combines traditional log cabin character, recreational opportunities, and exceptional privacy in a beautiful natural setting
